title: Roosevelt signs the Lend-Lease Act
summary: President Franklin D. Roosevelt signed a law allowing the United States to lend or lease weapons and supplies to any country whose defence was vital to American security.
reason: Britain was running out of money to buy American arms, and Roosevelt wanted to help it without entering the war.
significance: It made the United States the 'arsenal of democracy', supplying Britain, the Soviet Union, China and others with goods worth tens of billions of dollars.
place: White House, Washington, D.C., United States
